Deep Sea Gardens

By Ada Current

Researchers have mapped a thriving garden of glass sponges along a cold ridge in the northern ocean. The survey combines several years of sonar readings with samples gathered by a remotely operated vehicle.

The team says the habitat shelters juvenile fish and stores carbon in layers of sediment. A follow-up expedition will measure how the community changes through the winter darkness.
